sources.title: Sara L. Gonzalez, Darren Modzelewski, Lee M. Panich and Tsim D. Schneider, “Archaeology for the Seventh Generation” (2006), institutional repository substantive abstract.
sources.citation: Sara L. Gonzalez, Darren Modzelewski, Lee M. Panich and Tsim D. Schneider, “Archaeology for the Seventh Generation,” American Indian Quarterly 30, nos. 3–4 (2006): 388–415. doi: 10.1353/aiq.2006.0023. Substantive opening account reproduced as Abstract in Santa Clara University’s institutional repository.

verification.note: The full substantive institutional Abstract was freshly read, including its explicit account of Wilson’s use of Fanon and Freire and its discussion of community traditions and praxis. Complete article and Wilson’s original 2004 chapter unread. No print-page locator for the quoted passage is invented. This is named scholarly mediation, not a primary Wilson acknowledgment read directly.

source_addenda.rea_turner_deloria_historiography_2002: Addendum 2026-10-25 (dedicated Angela Cavender Wilson review): publisher PDF printed pp. 16 and 20 freshly read, including the surrounding paragraphs and Wilson 1997 bibliography entry on p. 24. Deloria explicitly uses her account of oral tradition and discusses its methodological tension. These selected readings extend the earlier pp. 6–10 check without claiming the whole chapter read. The body of Wilson’s cited 1997 essay remains unread. The older Turner claim and its qualifications remain intact.
